faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find yours? Ask in the chat itself

items.a: Tap "Try {days} days free" and say hi on WhatsApp. It works on your phone or your computer.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You get {days} days with everything in Premium, counted from your first message. No card needed.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: The diary stops logging until you choose a plan. Everything you logged stays saved and comes back in full when you subscribe.

items.q: How do I pay and cancel?
items.a: Right in the chat: reply "subscribe", choose your plan and pay by Pix or card. Cancel whenever you like; your access lasts until the end of the period you paid for.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: Within 7 days of paying, ask for a refund in the chat and it goes through on its own, as the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code provides.
No. The diary logs, adds up and informs; it doesn't prescribe diets or workouts. Its suggestions are general, based on your goal.
It's used only for your diary. Say "delete my data" and everything is deleted, as Brazil's data protection law (LGPD) provides.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.site: This site does not ask for or store personal data. With your permission in the cookie notice, Google Analytics and the Meta pixel count visits and measure ads; without it, none of them is loaded. Your choice stays only in your browser and can be changed through the Cookies link in the footer.
privacy.whatsapp: On WhatsApp, what you log is used only for your diary. Say "delete my data" and everything is deleted, as Brazil's data protection law (LGPD) provides.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.scope: The diary logs, adds up and informs: it doesn't prescribe diets or workouts and doesn't replace a nutritionist, doctor or personal trainer. Food values come from the Brazilian Food Composition Table (TACO, NEPA/Unicamp) and from Open Food Facts, under the ODbL license.
